title: Dosa Flip Flip | Fun Manipuri Kids Song for Little Ones | Manipuri Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Ei manung ama dosa flip flip ngamda chamgi tana, nupi aduda sumang, chatna hulchu.
Taraga nupi-pa-nupi pumnamgi tadang mayek chatlibagi lamtang ama lanbee.
Leikhutsa nupi-pa-nupi sodi nganaba khudong lakpa, tamsing amada cha changhanba.

Dosa dosa, kar kar kar kar
chur chur chur, slip tounu
flip flip flip flip
dosa yamna nachna taurei, kaya maja

hus, mathakta chatle, yamna mathakta, yamna mathakta
dosa hawada udli
ima ima, lau lau
plap! chamchana safe oina dosa thamli

dosa dosa, kar kar kar kar
chur chur chur, slip tounu
flip flip flip flip
dosa yamna nachna taurei, kaya maja

da da kakli, "hure, hure!" hairi
ichal khut tanani, tanani
rol rol rol tou, dosa hairi
alunа ai crispy rol

dosa dosa, kar kar kar kar
chur chur chur, slip tounu
flip flip flip flip
dosa yamna nachna taurei, kaya maja

dub dub dub dub dub, sangba chatnida
imana pumnamakta plet ama piri
yam yam yam yam, pumnamak chari
achouba nokpa nokpa, loire! dosa dosa kakau
